extracted.intended_audience: Japanese language learners and mobile app users seeking a dictionary/learning tool
extracted.subtask_description: Criteria and feature/quality expectations for a mobile Japanese dictionary and study app (search, handwriting recognition, flashcards, example sentences, UX, stability, sync, audio). Useful for evaluating or specifying such an app.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lightning Fast Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Search from over 180,000 dictionary entries and 58,000 example sentences and see the most relevant results as you type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasises speed and relevance-as-you-type. Metric covers indexing size (180k entries, 58k examples), latency, and quality/relevance of results. Page links to 'Learn more about Search' for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handwriting Recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: Draw any kanji or kana with handwriting recognition and Japanese will decipher and display the most likely character.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supports drawing kanji/kana; should return likely matches. Page repeats this feature: 'Draw any kanji and have Japanese decipher and display the most likely kanji or kana.' Evaluation should include recognition accuracy, supported character set, and UI for drawing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Memorize Lists (word lists)
rubrics_metrics.description: Save your favorite words, your daily go-tos and those tricky ones you can't help but forget in easily manageable lists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers creation, organization, editing, and manageability of user word lists; includes ability to save favorites and curate study lists. Useful for spaced repetition/workflow integration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Study Flashcards
rubrics_metrics.description: Create and customise flashcard lists, and then practice them until mastered with Japanese’s new and improved flashcard system.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate flashcard creation/customization options, study modes, progress/tracking (mastery), and effectiveness of practice algorithms. 'Practice until mastered' implies mastery tracking and repetition scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extensive Example Sentences
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains 58,000 example sentences to show usage and context for dictionary entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess breadth and quality of example sentences per entry, relevance, naturalness, and usefulness for learners. User reviews praise 'multiple example sentences' as a strong point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kanji Writing Demonstration / Stroke Order
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstration of how to write kanji properly (as noted in user reviews).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate presence and clarity of stroke order animations or diagrams, accuracy of stroke order, and usefulness for learning to write kanji.

rubrics_metrics.name: JLPT Level Support and Suitability
rubrics_metrics.description: Useful for learning and studying JLPT levels (users report using it for JLPT study; e.g., 'useful for learning to write and study JLPT levels').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess whether entries/cards are tagged or organized by JLPT level (N5–N1), and whether study features support JLPT preparation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Furigana Toggle and Card Customization
rubrics_metrics.description: Ability to switch on/off the furigana on the kanji and choose only kanji cards instead of English/Kanji.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate customisation options for flashcards and dictionary display (furigana visibility, card types, reading-only or kanji-only modes). Supports learner preference and progressive exposure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audio / Pronunciation Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Users request pronunciation; reports like 'can't speak, no sound when tap speak' and 'So good. Just need some pronunciation.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metric includes presence/coverage/quality of audio (native-speaker recordings or TTS), play-on-tap behavior, and completeness across entries. Missing audio noted as a usability gap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text Lookup / Clipboard Paste Feature Robustness
rubrics_metrics.description: Text feature for pasting text and looking up words — several users report crashes or failures ('App crashes when trying to use the text option to look up the words', 'text feature doesn't work... keeps crashing when I press paste').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate reliability and correctness of the text/lookup workflow, ability to handle katakana and pasted text, error handling, and crash-resistance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stability and Crash Resilience
rubrics_metrics.description: App should not crash during common operations (users report crashes in text lookup).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Measure crash frequency, handling of edge cases, and robustness across devices/OS versions. User complaints highlight crashes as a critical negative point.

rubrics_metrics.name: Import/Export and Cross-Device Sync
rubrics_metrics.description: User desires import/export functionality and iCloud sync so lists can be used on Mac and other devices ('I haven’t figured the import / export... would be nice if this was synced in iCloud').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess import/export formats, ease of migrating data (e.g., from Duolingo), and availability/quality of cloud sync (iCloud/other) across platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of Dictionary Coverage (including katakana handling)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coverage should include various registers and scripts; one user noted 'doesn't translates katakana'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate how well the dictionary handles kana/katakana loanwords, slang, dialects, and coverage completeness for learner needs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Monetization / Paid Features Transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Some study methods are behind paywalls for some users; another review highlights the app is 'entirely free' but also mentions paid study methods.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate which features are free vs paid, clarity of in-app purchases, and the impact of paywalls on learning workflows.

rubrics_metrics.name: User Experience and Polish
rubrics_metrics.description: High polish of user experience and card use ('Incredible polish of user experience and card use').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess UI/UX quality, navigation, discoverability, polish, and how design choices support learning. Positive UX noted as a strength in reviews.

rubrics_metrics.name: Practical Helpfulness for Study and Memorization
rubrics_metrics.description: App is described as 'great for students... helps to understand the role of Kanji' and 'helps memorize and learn new words each day' and 'one of the best tools... for memorization of key components'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluate overall effectiveness as a study companion: retention outcomes, study workflows, integration with other methods, and learner-reported success.
